title: Indian Researchers Explore Neuromorphic AI Hardware
summary: Researchers in India are investigating neuromorphic computing architecture as an alternative to GPUs for demanding AI workloads.

title: Hermeus Pairs Quarterhorse with Ramjet-X
summary: Hermeus has revealed plans to use its Quarterhorse supersonic aircraft to launch the Ramjet-X high-Mach test vehicle.

title: Infineon Launches Smart Power Stage Family
summary: Infineon is sampling a dual-phase smart power stage family featuring a power density exceeding 2 A/mm² for AI accelerators.

title: Roman Telescope Deploys Systems and Powers On
summary: NASA's newly launched Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope deployed its solar array and communication systems and powered on its Coronagraph Instrument.

title: Digital Twin and Cobot Paired for Remote AM Finishing
summary: Researchers successfully tested a digital twin and cobot system to allow operators to remotely program and supervise metal AM finishing.

title: Swarmer to Acquire Ratel Robotics
summary: Software developer Swarmer plans to acquire Ukrainian unmanned ground vehicle maker Ratel Robotics for up to $224 million.

title: Comau Automates Logistics for Decathlon
summary: Comau deployed an automated system for Decathlon featuring its MyCo cobot, ROS2 software, AI-powered vision, and a modular gripper.

title: LINK Spacecraft Misses Orbit Boost for NASA's Swift
summary: Operations continue aboard the Katalyst Space LINK satellite despite its failure to boost NASA's Swift Observatory orbit.

title: Event-Based Perception System Coordinates Aerial and Ground Robots
summary: EVPeriscope uses an upward-facing event camera on a ground robot to track and control a quadrotor via propeller signatures.

title: Learning Agent-Based Model Predictive Control Enhances Vehicle Performance
summary: A novel hybrid control scheme combines model-based AMPC with Gaussian process regression to improve multi-agent vehicle performance.

title: Truncated Noisy Best-Response Algorithms Provide Game Theoretic Guarantees
summary: A family of asynchronous algorithms offers performance and safety bounds for multi-agent coordination with submodular maximization objectives.

title: Open Spectrum Architecture Integrates Multi-Service Coexistence
summary: The Open Spectrum architecture combines spectrum, services, and infrastructure into a shared pool orchestrated by an intelligent controller.

title: Acoustic Guidance Enables Automatic Docking for Autonomous Underwater Vehicles
summary: A fully acoustic sensing architecture using Ultrashort Baseline sensors allows autonomous underwater vehicles to dock without precise position knowledge.

title: Predefined-Time Consensus Achieved Under Denial-of-Service Attacks
summary: A switching sliding-mode protocol enables nonlinear multi-agent systems to achieve position and velocity consensus during DoS attacks.

title: Real-Time Jacobian Estimation Enables Rapid In-Hand Robot Writing
summary: An embodied control approach using real-time task Jacobian estimation allows anthropomorphic robot hands to perform in-hand pen writing.

title: Monocular Visual-SLAM Detects Hidden Tomatoes for Robotized Harvesting
summary: A cost-effective monocular camera Visual-SLAM system maps greenhouse crops and identifies occluded tomatoes using hierarchical localization.

title: SEED-UMI Exoskeleton Framework Improves Robot Imitation Learning
summary: Researchers introduced SEED-UMI, a shared exoskeleton framework for humans and robots that improves data collection efficiency and task success rates for dexterous hands.

title: Constructing Control Lyapunov-Barrier Functions from CLF-CBF Pairs
summary: This study establishes a method to construct control Lyapunov-barrier functions from existing Lyapunov and barrier functions to ensure safe stabilization in nonlinear systems.

title: ORCH Framework Enables Collective Intelligence in Embodied AI
summary: A new framework called ORCH applies human organization principles to improve task execution and coordination in large multi-agent artificial intelligence teams.

title: Reflex-Informed Reinforcement Learning for Muscle-Driven Locomotion
summary: A neuromuscular reinforcement learning framework integrates phase-dependent reflex controllers with residual learning to generate physiologically plausible and robust human locomotion.

title: MC-DeTra Improves Joint Object Detection and Trajectory Forecasting
summary: MC-DeTra adds motion-consistency mechanisms to autonomous driving models to improve socially-aware trajectory forecasting without adding inference latency.

title: Mixed-Integer Optimization for Military Aircraft Fleet Management
summary: A new multi-year planning strategy uses mixed-integer optimization and receding-horizon approaches to maximize long-term military aircraft fleet availability.

title: hp-Adaptive Trees for Efficient Graph Signal Approximation
summary: Researchers developed an hp-refinement strategy using binary knapsack problems and local embeddings to improve the approximation efficiency of graph signals.

title: Aerodynamic Prior-Free Trajectory Tracking for Tail-Sitter UAVs
summary: A coordinated control framework enables high-precision trajectory tracking for a tail-sitter UAV across the full flight envelope without requiring aerodynamic priors.

title: ActSafeGuard Enforces Constraints for Flow-Matching Policies
summary: ActSafeGuard introduces a differentiable, training-aligned safeguard layer that integrates hard physical action feasibility into robotic flow-matching policies.

title: Contact-Aware Control for Underactuated Aerial Manipulators
summary: A framework combining nonlinear model predictive control with incremental nonlinear dynamic inversion enables contact-aware aerial writing on an underactuated quadrotor.

title: Zuken Releases E3.series 2027 Design Software
summary: The updated software adds browser-based project access, 2D cabinet views, and expanded support for 3D panel and harness data.

title: TfL Publishes Climate Plan to Cut Emissions
summary: Transport for London released an updated environment plan featuring over 70 actions to reduce carbon emissions and improve network resilience.

title: IBM and Lockheed Martin Open Swiss Quantum Hub
summary: The new innovation hub will house Switzerland's first IBM Quantum System Two to support research, education, and workforce development.

title: Tackling Silent Data Errors in Data Centers
summary: Advanced manufacturing screening, design-for-test architectures, and fleet monitors are helping mitigate silent data errors in hardware.
